entity: BF Borgers' former public-company clients: where they went after the 2024 SEC ban
what_we_add: 27 ex-clients at four Nigerian audit firms; 54 at one-partner firms, 72 at 2-5 partner firms, 17 at bigger firms; 75 of 218 with no later audit
why:
Bloomberg (Jun 2024) says nearly 40% of Borgers clients were stranded without a new auditor; ours is 75 of 218 (34%), same direction and within 25%. Accounting Today counts 125 ex-clients onboarded in Q2 2024, consistent with our 143 who moved.
No usable quote mentions the Nigerian firms or the firm-size split. Bloomberg's 40% is a June 2024 snapshot, ours runs later.
